title_as_printed: Isopiestic Measurements with Reference Solutions of Sodium Chloride Approximately 4 M
pressure_note: not applicable (isopiestic equilibrium of mixed KCl-NaCl solutions with NaCl reference solution at 25 C; no pressure stated)

value.what: total molality of the mixed KCl + NaCl solution in isopiestic equilibrium with NaCl reference of molality M

value2.what: molality of reference NaCl solution having the same solvent vapour pressure (carried forward from first row of each M block; filled down)

iso_ratio.what: isopiestic ratio R = M/m (m = total molality); NOT osmotic coefficient

composition.other_species: B = KCl, C = NaCl; x = mB/(mB+mC) is the KCl fraction of total molality; empty mC in the x = 1.0 row means pure KCl (no NaCl)

extra_unmapped: R (cor.) (isopiestic ratio corrected to exactly 4 M NaCl by authors)
notes: The M column is printed once per block and filled down. The x=1.0 row has mC printed as dots (not applicable, no NaCl). The R column 'R' is the measured isopiestic ratio of the original M; R(cor.) is the authors' correction to M = 4.
